environment.coverage: One fresh isolated real game session in Arrille's Tradehouse, using OpenMW camera, native UI and nearby loaded actors. No personal save loaded.

limits: Actor positions are projected into the camera viewport; occlusion and line of sight are not checked.
The test called native interface methods and created the in-game panel; it did not click each control with a physical mouse or assess every screen resolution.
No personal save, complete world redesign, NPC subjective experience or sustained frame-rate claim was tested.
